verdict.rationale: Spline's own docs say collaborators can "give feedback in place" in a shared file, which suggests some form of in-file commenting, but no comment feature is described in detail. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a comments feature, @-mentioning teammates, resolving threads, notifications, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can comment directly on designs, mention teammates, and resolve threads so review happens in the file, not in email

citations.quote: Several people can edit the same file at the same time and give feedback in place, the way they would in a 2D design tool.
It's multiplayer. Several people can edit the same file at the same time and give feedback in place
